svg.title: Entity relationship diagram (PostgreSQL schema, backend/conf/db/migration/V1__init.sql + Flyway)

g.text: Entity relationship diagram (PostgreSQL schema, backend/conf/db/migration/V1__init.sql + Flyway)
PK = primary key, FK = foreign key, UQ = unique
role : CUSTOMER | SERVICE_ADVISOR | TECHNICIAN | ADMIN | SYSTEM_MANAGER
status : SUBMITTED | APPROVED | REJECTED | BOOKED | CANCELLED
status : CONFIRMED | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED | CANCELLED | NO_SHOW
Created and owned by Flyway, which runs the
migrations from AppLoader when the Play app starts.
Play itself keeps no tables: the Play session cookie
is not used (auth is a bearer token in sessions), and
Play Evolutions is replaced by Flyway.
No foreign keys to the application tables.
